identity.title: ChartMoE: Mixture of Diversely Aligned Expert Connector for Chart Understanding

problem.claim: Improve automatic chart understanding for faithful data extraction and reliable chart-based analysis.

gap.claim: Existing multimodal large language models still struggle to provide faithful data and reliable analysis from charts alone.

contributions.claim: ChartMoE replaces the traditional linear projector with a mixture-of-experts connector to bridge the modality gap.
It initializes different experts using linear connectors trained on distinct alignment tasks, then refines the connector and LLM parameters through high-quality knowledge learning.
ChartMoE-Align provides nearly 1 million chart-table-JSON-code quadruples for chart-table, chart-JSON, and chart-code alignment tasks.

stated_novelty.claim: The proposed distinction is a diversely initialized MoE connector built from connectors aligned to different chart-related tasks.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that ChartMoE improves the previous state-of-the-art accuracy on ChartQA from 80.48% to 84.64%.
The authors report experiments demonstrating the effectiveness of the MoE connector and its initialization strategy.

narrative_sequence.summary: Chart understanding is presented as important for comprehension and document parsing.
Although domain alignment and fine-tuning have enabled strong MLLM chart capabilities, faithful chart-only data and analysis remain difficult.
ChartMoE uses an MoE connector whose experts are diversely initialized from connectors trained on distinct alignment tasks.
The method is paired with a nearly million-example alignment dataset; the authors report a ChartQA increase from 80.48% to 84.64%.

source_observation.claim: The abstract links each expert's initialization to a distinct alignment task and separately identifies the corresponding chart-table-JSON-code dataset.

lessons.interpretation: A modular method claim can be made more concrete by mapping architectural components to the supervision or data structure that initializes them.
lessons.application: When introducing specialized modules, explicitly pair each module with its training signal and name the data representation supporting that signal.
lessons.exception: This framing is unsuitable when modules share identical supervision or when the data-to-component mapping is not meaningful.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify ChartQA evaluation conditions, baselines beyond the cited accuracy, statistical variation, or task-level breakdowns.
Details of the three alignment tasks and the reported knowledge-learning procedure are not provided.
